decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service sits outside the maritime core and shows no quantified results after two years, but it reuses the existing crewing network at low cost, so the option stays open for now with a meaningful risk of being dropped.
Superyacht crew recruitment fits closely with the firm's crewing capabilities and is cheap to maintain, so keeping the option open is justified while demand becomes clearer.
The Smart Academy is gaining traction, reaching six partner institutions within months of its launch, which signals growing value worth further commitment.

FuelEU monitoring and compliance is a regulatory necessity for clients and has a demonstrated success in meeting the submission deadline, so uncertainty about its value has largely resolved in its favour.
The dashboard is integrated into the PAL software at low marginal cost and supports the firm's digital and environmental strategy as FuelEU requirements ramp up.
The cost simulator is an embedded software feature that is cheap to keep, and its value should grow as FuelEU penalties and pooling decisions become relevant to clients.
